rule: Use Python plot generators for all real plots and technical diagrams. Use an existing generator before creating a new one. Generic one-dimensional failure timelines with only an x-axis, X/cross markers or censor markers stay SVG-native. As soon as a graphic has a y-axis, object rows, ablesbare Achsenskalierung, data points, curves, fit lines, probability nets, distributions or confidence limits, the Python-plot workflow applies. Python plots must not include visible titles. Python plot generators export SVG only. Plot text is optimized for small seminar-scene usage: axis labels, tick labels, and legends must remain readable when scaled down. Animation-ready plot SVGs follow components/python-plot-library/svg-animation-structure.provisional.md until the project-wide animation structure exists. Weibull confidence limits are drawn as reproducible, non-parallel 5 and 95 percent bootstrap boundary curves, not filled confidence bands or linear regression confidence lines. Multi-slide plot build-up sequences must share one documented data and axis contract across sorting, probability plotting, fit, parameter readout and confidence-limit stages.
